section.content: 本实用新型公开了生物基因检测设备技术领域的一种生物基因用基因试剂盒，包括试剂盒本体和上盖，所述上盖通过铰链转动连接在所述试剂盒本体的后侧壁上侧，所述试剂盒本体的内侧壁上侧插接有卡板，所述卡板的顶部自前向后等距开设有试管孔，所述试剂盒本体的内侧壁前后两侧且位于所述卡板的下方固定连接有安装座，所述安装座的内部固定连接有电加热管，该生物基因用基因试剂盒，结构设计合理，从根本上避免试管之间发生碰撞现象，提高了本装置对于试管收纳的稳定性，有效增加了本装置的工作效率，同时最大程度上提高了本装置对于试管使用的安全性与洁净效果，避免对试管的使用造成不必要的影响，保证了后续检测的数据精准性与可靠性。

The utility model discloses a gene kit for biological genes in the technical field of biological gene detection equipment, which comprises a kit body and an upper cover, wherein the upper cover is rotatably connected to the upper side of the rear side wall of the kit body through a hinge, a clamping plate is inserted on the upper side of the inner side wall of the kit body, test tube holes are equidistantly formed in the top of the clamping plate from front to back, mounting seats are fixedly connected to the front side and the back side of the inner side wall of the kit body and are positioned below the clamping plate, and an electric heating tube is fixedly connected inside the mounting seats, so that the gene kit for biological genes has a reasonable structural design, fundamentally avoids collision among test tubes, improves the stability of the device for accommodating the test tubes, effectively increases the working efficiency of the device, and simultaneously improves the safety and the cleaning effect of the device for the use of the test tubes to the greatest extent, unnecessary influence on the use of the test tube is avoided, and the accuracy and the reliability of subsequent detection data are ensured.

Gene kit for biological geneTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of biological gene detection equipment, in particular to a gene kit for biological genes.

Background

The gene is a basic unit of heredity, a DNA or RNA sequence carrying genetic information is copied to transmit the genetic information to the next generation, so that the character expression of an individual organism is controlled, the detection of the DNA by blood, other body fluids or cells is a main mode of gene detection, and the gene detection can diagnose diseases and can also be used for predicting the risk of the diseases.

In the prior art, test tubes are usually adopted for storing samples and are loaded, then the test tubes carrying the samples are placed in a kit for storage, but the traditional kit cannot fix the positions of the bottoms of the test tubes, so that the test tubes are in mutual impact in the kit due to shaking in the moving process of the kit, the samples in the test tubes are easy to leak, even the bottoms of the test tubes are damaged due to impact, irreversible accidents occur, and the actual working efficiency is seriously influenced, on the other hand, the test tubes need to be cleaned after being used and then are placed in the kit again, but because the kit does not have the drying and sterilizing functions, the bacteria are bred due to the residue of liquid in the test tubes, the subsequent use is influenced, and the accuracy and the reliability of detection data are greatly reduced, therefore, we propose a gene kit for a biological gene.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to provide a gene kit for biological genes, which aims to solve the problems that the traditional kit cannot fix the position of the bottom of a test tube, so that the test tubes collide with each other in the kit due to shaking in the moving process of the kit, samples in the test tube are easy to leak, and even the bottom of the test tube is damaged due to collision, and on the other hand, the test tube needs to be cleaned after being used and then is put into the kit again, but the reagent kit does not have the function of drying and sterilizing, so that bacteria are bred due to the residue of liquid in the test tube.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model provides the following technical scheme: a gene kit for biological genes comprises a kit body and an upper cover, wherein the upper cover is rotationally connected to the upper side of the rear side wall of the kit body through a hinge, the upper side of the inner side wall of the kit body is inserted with a clamping plate, the top of the clamping plate is provided with test tube holes at equal intervals from front to back, the front side and the back side of the inner side wall of the kit body are fixedly connected with mounting seats below the clamping plates, the inside of the mounting seat is fixedly connected with an electric heating pipe, the bottom of the inner cavity of the kit body is fixedly connected with a shock absorber, the center of the shock absorber is horizontally aligned with the center of the test tube hole, the top connecting end of the shock absorber is fixedly connected with a sucker, the lamp holders are fixedly connected to the left side and the right side of the top of the inner cavity of the upper cover, the UV lamp tubes are inserted between the two lamp holders, and the UV lamp tubes are located right above the clamping plates.

Preferably, the top center of the upper cover is fixedly connected with a handle, and the outer side wall of the handle is sleeved with an anti-slip sleeve.

Preferably, the upper side of the front side wall of the kit body is provided with a socket, the lower side of the front side wall of the upper cover is fixedly connected with a plug-in buckle, and the plug-in buckle is plugged in the socket.

Preferably, a clip-shaped groove is formed in the periphery of the top of the kit body, a clip-shaped bump is integrally formed on the periphery of the bottom of the upper cover, and the clip-shaped bump is inserted into the clip-shaped groove.

Preferably, an O-shaped rubber ring is bonded to the inner side wall of the test tube hole.

Preferably, the lower side of the front side wall of the kit body is fixedly connected with a controller through a bolt, and the output end of the controller is electrically connected with the electric heating pipe and the input end of the UV lamp tube.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that: 1. this gene kit for biological gene, inner chamber bottom through at the kit body sets up the sucking disc, and set up the bumper shock absorber in the bottom of sucking disc, because the bottom of test tube is comparatively smooth, the adsorptivity that utilizes the sucking disc is effectively fixed to the bottom of test tube, fundamentally avoids the phenomenon of colliding between the test tube, improved the stability that this device accomodate to the test tube, utilize the bumper shock absorber to fully absorb carrying the produced vibrations of process to the test tube simultaneously, further improved the stability of test tube carrying the in-process, the work efficiency of this device has effectively been increased.

2. This gene kit for biological gene, inside through at kit body and upper cover sets up electric heating pipe and UV fluorescent tube respectively, electric heating pipe is heat energy with electric energy conversion, make its inside to the kit body heat up the processing, thereby carry out drying process to remaining liquid on the inside and outside wall of test tube, recycle UV fluorescent tube and send ultraviolet ray to the inside and outside wall of test tube on, the thallus that multiplies on to the test tube through ultraviolet ray goes out to kill and handles, in order to reach the mesh of disinfecting to the test tube surface, the security and the clean effect of this device to the test tube use have been improved to the at utmost, avoid causing the unnecessary influence to the use of test tube, the accurate and reliability of data of follow-up detection has been guaranteed.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic view of the overall structure of the present invention;

FIG. 2 is a schematic view of the connection structure between the main body and the upper cover of the kit according to the present invention;

FIG. 3 is a schematic sectional view of the main body of the kit according to the present invention.

In the figure: 100. a kit body; 110. a controller; 120. a socket; 130. a clip groove; 140. clamping a plate; 150. a test tube hole; 151. an O-shaped rubber ring; 160. a mounting seat; 170. an electric heating tube; 180. a shock absorber; 190. a suction cup; 200. an upper cover; 210. inserting and buckling; 220. a clip-shaped bump; 230. a lamp socket; 240. a UV lamp tube; 250. a handle.

Detailed Description

The utility model provides a gene kit for biological genes, which improves the stability of the device for accommodating test tubes and simultaneously improves the safety and the cleaning effect of the device for using the test tubes to the maximum extent, and please refer to fig. 1-3, and the gene kit comprises a kit body 100 and an upper cover 200.

Referring to fig. 1-3 again, the upper side of the inner sidewall of the kit body 100 is inserted with a clamping plate 140, the top of the clamping plate 140 is provided with test tube holes 150 at an equal distance from front to back, the front and back sides of the inner sidewall of the kit body 100 are fixedly connected with mounting seats 160 below the clamping plate 140, the interior of the mounting seats 160 is fixedly connected with an electric heating tube 170, the bottom of the inner cavity of the kit body 100 is fixedly connected with a shock absorber 180, the center of the shock absorber 180 is horizontally aligned with the center of the test tube holes 150, the top connecting end of the shock absorber 180 is fixedly connected with a suction cup 190, the kit body 100 is used for installing and connecting the clamping plate 140, the mounting seats 160, the shock absorber 180 and the upper cover 200, the clamping plate 140 is used for fixing the tops of test tubes, the test tube holes 150 are used for placing the test tubes, thereby performing limiting treatment on the outer sidewalls thereof, and the mounting seats 160 are used for installing the electric heating tubes 170, and with external power input to electric heating pipe 170 in, electric heating pipe 170 is used for converting electric energy into heat energy to carry out the intensification to the inside of kit body 100 and handle, bumper shock absorber 180 is used for installing fixed to sucking disc 190, and absorbs the vibrations of transmitting in sucking disc 190, and sucking disc 190 is used for adsorbing fixedly inserting the bottom to the test tube in test tube hole 150, in order to reach the purpose of fixing a position the test tube.

Referring to fig. 1 to 3 again, the lamp sockets 230 are fixedly connected to the left and right sides of the top of the inner cavity of the upper cover 200, the UV lamp 240 is inserted between the two lamp sockets 230, the UV lamp 240 is located right above the clamping plate 140, the upper cover 200 is rotatably connected to the upper side of the rear side wall of the reagent kit body 100 through a hinge, the upper cover 200 is used for sealing the top of the reagent kit body 100, so that an independent sealed space is formed outside the test tube, the lamp sockets 230 are used for mounting the UV lamp 240 and providing power output for the UV lamp 240, the UV lamp 240 is used for emitting ultraviolet light to the upper side of the test tube in the reagent kit body 100, and the surface of the test tube is sterilized by the ultraviolet light.

Referring to fig. 2 again, in order to facilitate the carrying of the device by the worker and avoid the falling-off phenomenon caused by the slippery hand, a handle 250 is fixedly connected to the center of the top of the upper cover 200, and an anti-slip sleeve is sleeved on the outer side wall of the handle 250.

Referring to fig. 1-2 again, in order to improve the operational practicability between the reagent cartridge body 100 and the upper cover 200, the upper side of the front side wall of the reagent cartridge body 100 is provided with a socket 120, the lower side of the front side wall of the upper cover 200 is fixedly connected with a plug 210, and the plug 210 is plugged into the socket 120.

Referring to fig. 1 again, in order to improve the connection sealing performance between the reagent kit body 100 and the upper cover 200 and prevent the test tubes therein from being contaminated by external impurities, a circle of the top of the reagent kit body 100 is provided with a clip groove 130, a circle of the bottom of the upper cover 200 is integrally formed with a clip projection 220, and the clip projection 220 is inserted into the clip groove 130.

Referring to fig. 3 again, in order to improve the protection of the test tube placement in the test tube hole 150 and avoid unnecessary damage to the surface of the test tube, an O-ring 151 is adhered to the inner sidewall of the test tube hole 150.

Referring to fig. 1-2 again, in order to facilitate the working state of the electric heating tube 170 and the UV lamp 240 to be electrically controlled by the operator, and to improve the operation convenience of the apparatus, the top of the upper cover 200 is fixedly connected with the controller 110 through the bolt, and the output end of the controller 110 is electrically connected to the input ends of the electric heating tube 170 and the UV lamp 240.

When the kit is used specifically, a person skilled in the art firstly closes the socket 120 to lock the plug-in buckle 210, then holds the handle 250 by hand and drives the upper cover 200 to rotate upwards, so that the upper cover 200 is separated from the kit body 100, then takes out the test tube on the clamping plate 140, pours the sample into the test tube, sequentially aligns the test tube into the test tube hole 150 to be inserted, lightly presses the test tube to be connected with the sucking disc 190 at the bottom, and adsorbs and fixes the bottom of the test tube by using the sucking disc 190, and repeats the steps until the use of all the test tubes in the clamping plate 140 is completed, at this time, rotates the upper cover 200 downwards so that the plug-in buckle 210 is re-inserted into the socket 120, namely, the connection between the upper cover 200 and the kit body 100 is completed, the worker holds the handle 250 by hand to move the kit body 100 into the corresponding working area, and after the use of the test tube is completed, the worker sequentially cleans the test tube and then puts the test tube hole 150 again, then close upper cover 200, through controller 110 at first start electric heating pipe 170, make it convert the electric power of input into heat energy, dry the processing to all remaining water droplets on the inside and outside wall of test tube simultaneously, stand 20 minutes after closing electric heating pipe 170, start UV fluorescent tube 240 simultaneously, make it send ultraviolet light to the top of kit body 100, utilize the sterilizing effect of ultraviolet light to carry out germicidal treatment to the thallus that breeds on the test tube surface, accomplish the use to this device promptly.
